For a truly always-on server: 1) grant “All files access” so the whole phone storage can be served, 2) allow ignoring battery optimizations, and 3) on some brands (Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo…) also set this app to “No restrictions” / lock it in Recents so the system does not kill it.

Samsung detected (Android 13 / One UI): Samsung aggressively kills background apps. To keep PhoneFTP running 24/7:
1) Settings → Apps → PhoneFTP → Battery → “Unrestricted”.
2) Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → “Never sleeping apps” → add PhoneFTP.
3) Lock PhoneFTP in Recents (⋮ menu → Lock this app).
